**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is looking to buy a home.
- [FACT] The user is currently waiting to hear back on an offer they made on a home.
- [CHANGE] The user has been considering buying a home seriously after their rent increased for the third time in two years.
- [EVENT] The user has been doing research and preparing for the homebuying process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A home inspection is a thorough examination of a property's condition by a licensed professional.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The home inspection process typically includes an examination of the exterior, interior, major systems, appliances, and structural components of the property.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common findings during a home inspection include roof damage, siding issues, plumbing leaks, outdated electrical panels, HVAC problems, foundation issues, and pest infestations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] After the inspection, the inspector provides a detailed report that includes a summary, deficiencies, and recommendations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can request repairs or credits from the seller based on the inspection findings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should categorize inspection report findings into safety hazards, major systems, structural concerns, cosmetic issues, and maintenance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should evaluate the cost and impact of each finding to prioritize requests from the seller.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should be flexible and open to compromise during negotiations with the seller.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can tackle cosmetic issues and regular maintenance on their own after closing.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/21 (Sun) at 23:20.
